name: Valerian — hourly market-residual signal ladder (1h–7d lookbacks, 1h–24h targets) with a Gârleanu–Pedersen aim-tracking controller calibrated to 21 bp, hourly decisions, PIT 273-asset Kraken panel
mechanism:
DATA FLOW. One streaming pass over the 24 GB minute table (`docs/infrastructure.md:47`) generalising `aggregate_asset_daily` (`trader/data.py:143-190`; bucket key ts//3600 instead of ts//86400) builds TRUE hourly OHLCV+trade_count bars for the `build_pit_universe` set (`trader/data.py:426-455`: USD-quoted, non-stable/fiat; PIT via present-mask, dead coins retained; 819 liquidity gate `trader/data.py:57-90`). Panel ≈ 65.7k hours (2018-10→2026-03 minute canon, 899 seam) × ≤273 assets × 6 fields ≈ 0.86 GB float64, RAM-resident. Per asset-hour: residual return e_{i,t} = r_{i,t} − β̂_i r_{mkt,t} (β̂ trailing 30d hourly regression on equal-weight market, causal); σ̂_i from Yang–Zhang on the trailing 7×24 hourly bars. FEATURES (all cross-sectionally rank-standardised per hour): F1 residual-return ranks over lookbacks L ∈ {1,2,4,6,12,24,48,168} h; F2 range family — log(σ_Parkinson(L)/σ_YZ(7d)) at L ∈ {1,4,24} h and the Garman–Klass/close-close ratio (an intraday variance-ratio statistic, the OHLC-native content the vector line never used, memo A-2); F3 activity — log(V_L/V_7d) and log(tradecount_L/7d), dollar-volume rank; F4 state — UTC hour-of-day/day-of-week one-hots, cross-sectional 1h dispersion, market 1h/24h return and range shock (enter only as interactions, GBM arm). TARGET y_{i,t,h} = (e_{i,t→t+h})/σ̂_{i,t}, h ∈ {1,2,4,6,12,24} h, with a pre-registered 1-BAR ENTRY LAG (enter at open of t+1, as 816's G8) so bid-ask bounce/stale prints (BTC mid frozen 38.9% of capture time, `handoff_run_50.md:72`) cannot masquerade as reversal IC.

LEARNED OBJECTS, LOSS, REFIT. (i) Six ridge forecasters f_h (closed form, ~40 features, pooled across all assets = full parameter sharing), expanding window, weekly refit, purge ≥ h; plus a LightGBM twin per h (conjunctive/interaction estimator: reversal × volume-shock × hour-of-day × dispersion — the structure Bianchi–Babiak–Dickerson report) to test whether conditional structure adds IC over ridge at this horizon (the 811 question, never asked above 20 min). Loss: squared error on y (ridge) / L2 (GBM); the STATISTIC is per-hour cross-sectional Spearman IC. (ii) Signal dynamics: the combined score s_t is decomposed into k components by lookback band; each component's hourly autocorrelation gives an AR(1) decay φ_k; Σ = market + 3 PCs + diagonal (Ledoit–Wolf shrinkage on hourly residuals); N_eff = (Σλ)²/Σλ² of the residual correlation spectrum, measured per year (TASK_825's parked statistic). (iii) CONTROL LAW (Gârleanu–Pedersen 2013): aim_t = (γΣ)^{-1} Σ_k B_k f_t^k /(1+φ_k a/γ) — slower components weighted more; x_t = x_{t−1} + θ (aim_t − x_{t−1}) with θ = a/λ, λ calibrated so the marginal cost of the typical hourly trade equals 21 bp/side of Σ|Δw|; then a per-asset no-trade band |Δw_i| < 0.2% (RiskConfig band, `trader/config.py:126`), gross cap Σ|w| ≤ 1, per-asset cap 5%, shortability mask (non-marginable names clipped at w ≥ 0; net exposure reported every hour). Every trade is (aim − x) times θ: no learned policy, no HOLD state, no checkpoint. EXECUTION RULE: at each hour boundary, post at touch (maker) with a 5-min timeout then take; the 1–5 min `linear_xs` signal (IC 0.15/0.14, `806/result.md`) decides only whether to post now or wait one 5-min slot. The backtest charges 21 bp on Σ|Δw| INCLUDING drift re-trims (fixing `trader/backtest.py:221-227`'s target-weight-only accounting); the timing gain is a separate diagnostic never netted into the gate. Grading: daily-aggregated net return Sharpe × √365 (the goalpost unit; no per-bar annualisation — the 809 trap), on both a `trader/`-style hourly scorer and `eval_vector --bar-minutes 60` (stride path exercised at `eval_vector.py:172`), agreement within 0.1.
math:
UNITS. Hourly decisions; N_live ≈ 240–270; N_eff assumed 8 (to be measured; 5–15 plausible); typical residual daily vol σ_d = 350 bp ⇒ σ_1h = 71 bp. Score-proportional book w ∝ z, Σ|w| = 1: E[r_p]/hour = (E z²/E|z|)·IC_1h·σ_1h·TC = 1.25·IC_1h·71·TC bp; SD/hour = 1.25·σ_1h/√N_eff. Per day: gross = 24·1.25·71·TC·IC_1h = 2130·TC·IC_1h bp; cost = 24·τ_h·21 = 504·τ_h bp (τ_h = Σ|Δw| per hour); SD = √24·1.25·71/√N_eff = 435/√N_eff bp (= 154 bp at N_eff 8 → 29%/yr book vol). Net Sharpe +0.97/yr ⇔ 0.0508/day ⇔ 2130·TC·IC_1h − 504·τ_h ≥ 22.1/√N_eff bp/day (= 7.8 at N_eff 8; 9.9 at 5; 5.7 at 15).

TURNOVER IS SET BY SIGNAL PERSISTENCE, NOT BY DECISION FREQUENCY. For an AR(1) score with hourly autocorrelation ρ (half-life HL = −ln2/ln ρ) traded fully, τ_h = √(2(1−ρ)) — at ρ = 0 this is 1.41, exactly 816's measured 1.38–1.41 per rebalance at EVERY H (`PHASE1_RESULT.md` grid), i.e. 816's consecutive forecasts were uncorrelated noise re-trims. Under GP partial trading at rate θ the position is an EMA of the aim: TC(θ,ρ) = √((2θ−θ²)/(1−(1−θ)²ρ²)); Var(x)/Var(s) = θ/(2−θ)·(1+(1−θ)ρ)/(1−(1−θ)ρ); Cov(s_t,x_{t−1}) = θρ/(1−(1−θ)ρ); τ_h ≈ θ·SD(s_t − x_{t−1})/SD(x). Minimising required IC over θ:
HL = 6 h (ρ .891): θ* ≈ .03–.04, TC .54, τ 1.65/day, cost 35 bp/day → IC_1h ≥ 0.037 (N_eff 8).
HL = 24 h (ρ .9715): θ* ≈ .02–.03, TC .65–.73, τ .58–.71/day, cost 12–15 → IC_1h ≥ 0.0145.
HL = 3 d (ρ .9904): θ* ≈ .01–.02, TC .72–.83, τ .24–.34/day, cost 5–7 → IC_1h ≥ 0.0084.
HL = 30 d (ρ .99904): θ .01, TC .955, τ .077/day (≈ the 819 book's 0.155 order), cost 1.6 → IC_1h ≥ 0.0046 (≈ IC_24 0.023, consistent with the memo's 0.02–0.03 daily requirement; 898 measures that signal ≈ 0 since 2024).
Same signals traded RAW at daily stride: HL 24 h → ρ_day .50, τ 1.0/day, cost 21, IC_24 ≥ 0.066 ⇔ IC_1h ≥ 0.0185 (IC_24 ≈ IC_1h·Σρ^k/√24 = 3.57·IC_1h) — the hourly GP book needs ~22% less IC; HL 6 h → IC_24 ≥ 0.084 ⇔ IC_1h ≥ 0.048 vs 0.037 — ~25% less, and daily sampling aliases the signal away. Raw hourly re-trimming of a slow signal costs √24 ≈ 4.9× the daily book (sum of |increments| of a random walk) — 892's re-trim mode made quantitative; GP smoothing is what removes it (θ = .05 on a 3-day signal: τ .54/day at 92% of IC vs raw-daily .65/day).
FAST END (record anchors): at 1-min HL the required IC is unattainable (full turnover ≈ 30 bp/hour vs gross 1.25·0.15·9 bp ≈ 1.7 bp/min); 897 0/864 cells; Kitron–Wengrowicz gross 1.3 bp/trade vs 5 bp round trip at 15 min. SLOW END: 898 ≈ 0. The band HL ∈ [6 h, 3 d] requires IC_1h ∈ [0.037, 0.008] and has never been measured.
DETECTION POWER (why the instrument is decisive): per-hour IC SD under an exchangeable null ≈ 1/√(N−1) ≈ 0.063 (loops panel pt 4); 2024-01→2026-03 gives ≈19.7k hours → SE(mean IC) ≈ 0.063/√(19.7k/h) ≈ 0.0009 at h=4 before NW inflation; an IC of 0.01 is detectable at t ≫ 3. The economic line, not detection, is the bar.
EXECUTION TIMING VALUE: IC_5min 0.14 × σ_5min (350/√288 = 20.6 bp) × E|z| 0.8 ≈ 2.3 bp per unit traded (upper bound); at τ 0.6–1.6/day → 1.4–3.7 bp/day → 0.5–1.4 pp/yr → +0.02–0.05 Sharpe on a 29%-vol book. Second-order; the maker/taker tier (16 → 4–15 bp per the July-2026 ladder, loops panel pt 1) is 5–10× larger and is a fee fact, not learning.
MULTIPLICITY: Bailey–López de Prado E[max SR_N|H0] = SD_SR·[(1−γ)Φ⁻¹(1−1/N) + γΦ⁻¹(1−1/(Ne))], SD_SR = 1/√2.25 yr = 0.667: SR0(1) = 0; SR0(12) = 1.11; SR0(48) = 1.51 — any Sharpe-selected best cell on the 2024–26 window clears +0.97 by luck alone, so selection must be on IC (Bonferroni, NW t ≥ 3) and exactly ONE pre-declared book is graded.
profit_source: FORECAST of the FIRST MOMENT: E[market-residual, vol-standardised return of asset i over the next 1–24 h | cross-sectional ranks of its 1h–7d residual returns, its range shock, its volume/trade-count shock, hour-of-day, market dispersion]. The hypothesised economic origin of that conditional mean is compensation for liquidity provision (short-horizon reversal after aggressive-flow moves — Nagel 2012 framing; Bianchi–Babiak–Dickerson 2022 and Kitron–Wengrowicz 2026 for crypto) plus any residual intermediate-horizon continuation; the mechanism does not assume the sign — ridge learns it per lookback. A second, strictly separate and separately reported component is COST REDUCTION: GP partial trading (removes the √24 re-trim penalty) and maker-first execution timed by the 1–5 min signal (≈2 bp per unit traded). Nothing here is a rebalancing premium or a risk premium harvested by construction; if the conditional mean is zero the book's expected gross is zero and net is −turnover × 21 bp (the loops panel's iterated-expectations identity).
why_learning: Honestly: most of this is estimation, not learning, and that is a feature. What a closed-form single-feature estimator cannot do as efficiently: (1) POOLING — 273 assets × ~65k hours ≈ 17M asset-hours share one coefficient vector per horizon, so a per-asset or per-feature estimator with ≤ 65k rows is dominated on variance; the cross-sectional rank standardisation makes the pooled ridge a well-posed panel estimator. (2) COMBINATION ACROSS LOOKBACKS AND HORIZONS with data-estimated decay — the GP aim weights 1/(1+φ_k a/γ) need φ_k and B_k jointly estimated from the IC autocorrelation and the per-horizon fits; a hand rule (e.g. 819's sign-of-30d) fixes both a priori. (3) CONDITIONAL/INTERACTION STRUCTURE — reversal conditional on volume shock, range shock, hour-of-day (Kraken's US/Asia session structure) and dispersion is a product structure; the GBM arm is the only object here that can find it, and 811's result (nonlinear = 40–60% of linear at 1–20 min) is the pre-registered prior that it will NOT add IC — the arm exists to test that at the new horizon, not to rescue a null ridge. What learning cannot do: create IC that the panel does not carry; a neural forecaster is excluded by pre-registration (variance at IC ~0.01–0.04, and the ceiling binds all classes alike).

bear_positive.argument: The market-residual target and Σw ≈ 0 make the book market-NEUTRAL by construction, so BEAR-positive reduces to 'does the edge exist in 2022', not to a short-market bet (memo A-3). If a liquidity-provision/reversal conditional mean exists, the literature's direction is favourable: reversal returns rise in high-volatility, low-liquidity states (Nagel 2012 for equities; Bianchi–Babiak–Dickerson 2022: concentrated in smaller, more volatile, less liquid crypto pairs). Two conditions can break it: (a) the Kraken spot-margin shortability mask clips shorts on most alts, leaving the book net long in a bear — hence net exposure is printed hourly and a >0.2 median net-long book fails the form check; (b) the edge may simply not exist in 2022 — BEAR22 is in-sample for the expanding fit and is a form check only; the binding unseen read is 2024-01→2026-03.

guards: 887 ADAPTIVE HOLD: there is no learned policy and no HOLD action — the position is a deterministic function x_t = x_{t−1} + θ(aim_t − x_{t−1}) of a forecast that is graded separately, so the collapse attractor cannot form; its honest analogue (aim inside the no-trade band for most names, or a DRO-style shrinkage μ̂ᵀφ − √δ‖φ‖ going flat) is pre-registered as FAIL: median Σ|w| < 0.5 or > 50% of hours with Σ|Δw| = 0 fails; DRO shrinkage is NOT used in the graded book. 892 RE-TRIM DAMAGE: quantified above (raw hourly re-trimming costs √24× the daily book); GP partial trading at θ* plus the 0.2% band is the closed-form fix; the book prints an hourly turnover decomposition (aim-driven vs noise vs drift vs universe entry/exit), charges drift re-trims (record correction 3, tactics panel), and must show gross − cost > 0 in each calendar year; the binding metric is the daily-aggregated net Sharpe × √365, never per-bar annualised (the 809 retraction). 813 SELECTION LUCK: fixed grid frozen in the SPEC (IC surface 8 L × 6 h × 3 families = descriptive single-feature ICs needing no fit; 12 FITTED cells = 6 ridge + 6 GBM); selection statistic is IC with Bonferroni over 12 and Newey–West t ≥ 3 (lag h), never Sharpe; block-Rademacher/circular-shift placebo replaces shuffled labels; ONE pre-declared GP book (all horizons combined by GP weights) is graded; SR0(N) reported beside every table: SR0(1) = 0, SR0(12) = 1.11, SR0(48) = 1.51 on 2.25 years — any Sharpe-selected cell would clear +0.97 by chance, which is why none is. BOUNCE/STALE-PRINT ARTIFACT (new, specific to hourly reversal): all ICs computed with a 1-bar entry lag; IC with vs without the lag is a pre-registered diagnostic — if IC collapses under the lag, the 'reversal' is bid-ask bounce and the cell is dead. SURVIVORSHIP: `build_pit_universe` + present-mask, dead coins retained, 819 liquidity gate. INSTRUMENT AGREEMENT: hourly `trader/`-style scorer and `eval_vector --bar-minutes 60` within 0.1 (the 882 discipline). EPOCH: post-E-d, minute canon to the 899 seam, PIT frame pinned per `LEDGER.md:28-41`.

literature.ref: Gârleanu, N. & Pedersen, L.H. (2013) 'Dynamic Trading with Predictable Returns and Transaction Costs', J. Finance 68(6); NBER w15205
literature.claim: Optimal policy under quadratic costs: trade partially toward an aim portfolio that is a weighted average of current and expected future Markowitz portfolios; predictors with slower mean reversion get more weight; commodity-futures implementation beats naive benchmarks net of costs.
literature.numbers: x_t = x_{t−1} + Λ⁻¹A(aim_t − x_{t−1}); aim_t = (γΣ)⁻¹Σ_k B_k f_t^k/(1+φ_k a/γ) (formulas from prior full reading, not re-verified here; NBER abstract confirms the qualitative statements)

literature.claim: IR ≈ TC · IC · √BR; BR = independent bets per year; TC = transfer coefficient of the implemented vs unconstrained portfolio.
literature.numbers: Used with BR = N_eff · 8760/h, TC = the GP smoothing ratio √((2θ−θ²)/(1−(1−θ)²ρ²))

controllability: Fully auditable, no checkpoint: the deployable artifact is six ridge coefficient vectors (≈40 numbers each, readable as 'rank of 6h residual return: −0.0x'), a decay vector φ_k, a covariance model, one trading rate θ, one band, one gross cap and a shortability mask. Every hour the aim portfolio is an explicit vector; every order equals θ·(aim_i − x_i) or zero inside the band, so any trade is explainable in one line. The operator can hard-cap turnover/day through λ (θ), force flat through the mask, and read gross/net exposure, turnover decomposition and IC-by-year as first-class outputs. Failure surfaces are visible (IC(h) curve going to zero; turnover decomposition dominated by noise) rather than latent (a policy drifting to HOLD). Refits are weekly, closed-form, reproducible bit-for-bit; the GBM arm, if ever used in the book, is the only non-transparent component and is excluded from the graded book unless it beats ridge IC by >20% CI-separated (811's own bar).
compute: CPU only; no GPU at any stage; the 64 GB cards are irrelevant. Aggregation: one streaming SQLite pass over the ~273 PIT USD-quoted assets' minute rows (order 5×10⁸ rows; 897 read 120.9M rows in 3.2 h including compute, so 1–2 h I/O-bound on the workstation NVMe, `safe_run`-wrapped). Hourly panel: 65.7k × 273 × 6 × 8 B ≈ 0.86 GB float64 in RAM (cache as a derived control-data file like 811's `_close_cache.npz`). Features ≈ 40 × ≤17.8M asset-hours × 4 B ≈ 2.7 GB float32. Ridge: X'X of 40×40 over ≤17.8M rows per refit — seconds; ~100 weekly refits × 6 horizons — minutes. IC surface + NW + block-Rademacher placebo (200 draws): minutes. GBM (LightGBM) monthly refits × 6 horizons ≈ 160 fits of 5–15 min on 16 cores → 0.5–1.5 CPU-days, on gpu-server CPU per the compute rule (`.claude/rules/10-compute-allocation.md`). GP book + bootstrap (n_boot 2000, block length from `901 range_variance_ratio`): minutes. Second instrument `eval_vector --bar-minutes 60` over 2024–26: CPU, under an hour. Total ≤ 2 CPU-days, ~1 week of implementer time.

kill_experiment.design: Pre-registered (SPEC sha256 recorded before the first fit), PIT hourly panel 2019-01→2026-03 (minute canon; 899 seam named), expanding-window fits, binding OOS window 2024-01→2026-03 reported by year (2024, 2025, 2026Q1), BEAR22 as an in-sample form check. STAGE 1 — IC×cost surface: (a) descriptive single-feature per-hour Spearman IC for 8 lookbacks × 6 horizons × 3 families (no fit, no selection), each with and without the 1-bar entry lag; (b) 12 fitted cells (ridge, GBM) × 6 horizons; (c) measured N_eff(year), σ̂_d, IC-autocorrelation → φ̂_k, and the GP-optimal θ*, TC and τ per cell; (d) the REQUIRED-IC line IC*_h = (504·τ̂ + 22.1/√N̂_eff)/(2130·TC(θ*,φ̂)) evaluated on the MEASURED quantities. STAGE 2 (only if Stage 1 G-A passes): the ONE pre-declared GP book combining all horizons by GP weights, Λ calibrated to 21 bp, band 0.2%, shortability mask, drift re-trims charged, scored on the hourly `trader/`-style scorer and `eval_vector --bar-minutes 60`, daily-aggregated net@21 Sharpe × √365, block bootstrap n_boot 2000, ≥3 seeds where randomness enters (GBM seeds, feature bootstrap for ridge).
kill_experiment.instrument: New small module `experiments/9xx_hourly_ladder/` importing `trader/data.py` (streaming aggregation generalised to ts//3600), `trader/backtest.py` `net_series`/`_sharpe`/bootstrap, `build_pit_universe` + present-mask; per-hour cross-sectional Spearman IC, Newey–West SE lag h, Bonferroni over the 12 fitted cells, block-Rademacher and circular-shift placebos (dependence-preserving nulls, loops panel), SR0(N) printed on every table; the GP controller as ~60 lines of numpy; `eval_vector.py --bar-minutes 60` as the second instrument (stride path at `eval_vector.py:172`); epoch pinned per `LEDGER.md:28-41`.
kill_experiment.pass_fail: G-A (signal in the band): ≥1 fitted cell with h ∈ {1,2,4,6} h whose mean IC on 2024-01→2026-03 ≥ its measured required line IC*_h, NW t ≥ 3 after Bonferroni(12), IC > 0 in each of 2024/2025/2026Q1, and IC under the 1-bar lag ≥ 70% of the un-lagged IC (else bounce artifact → cell dead). Fails everywhere ⇒ the 1h–6h band is closed for native OHLCV features; report the full IC(L,h) surface, N_eff, and the required-IC line so the closure is quantitative (expected shape: IC 0.005–0.02 detectable at t ≫ 3, below the line — 'real, cost-bound', as 897 and Kitron–Wengrowicz). G-B (book): daily-aggregated net@21 ≥ +0.97 with bootstrap CI lo > 0, positive in each of 2024/2025/2026Q1, BEAR22 form check > 0, median Σ|w| ≥ 0.5, <50% zero-trade hours, median |net exposure| ≤ 0.2, both instruments within 0.1; MARGINAL if ≥ +0.56 only; anything else FAIL. A G-A pass with a G-B fail is attributed to control/execution (turnover decomposition decides) and is the only legitimate re-entry for a search-based controller. No metric shopping: cells added later are a new row. Kill date 14 days from SPEC commit.
kill_experiment.cost: ≤ 2 CPU-days compute (1–2 h aggregation on the workstation, ridge/IC minutes, GBM 0.5–1.5 days on gpu-server CPU), zero GPU, ~1 implementer-week; a two-sided result either way.

honest_odds: P(G-A: some 1–6 h cell reaches its measured required-IC line, t ≥ 3, lag-robust) ≈ 12%. P(G-B +0.97 PIT | G-A) ≈ 40% (execution haircut on thin alts, shortability, N_eff below 8). Unconditional P(+0.97 net@21, PIT, 2024–26) ≈ 5%; P(≥ +0.56) ≈ 8–10%. Most likely outcome (~50%): IC 0.005–0.02 in the band, detectable at t ≫ 3, below the cost line — the same 'real, cost-bound' shape as 897 at minutes and Kitron–Wengrowicz at 15 min, on a venue where 21 bp/side is if anything optimistic for the low-activity pairs that carry the reversal premium (Bianchi et al.). Reasons the odds are not lower: the band is genuinely unmeasured; hourly IC detection is decisive; Fischer–Krauss–Deinert netted +7 bp/day at 120 min and 15 bp/side in 2018 (break-even ≈ 17–18 bp/side then); GP partial trading reduces the required IC by ~22–25% relative to any daily-stride book and is unmeasured here. Reasons not higher: that 2018 number was on a friendlier market and a 6-name concentrated book; 816 shows the minute information is gone by 4 h; the daily surface reads ≈ 0 since 2024; Kraken is a slow, thin tape (BTC mid frozen 38.9% of time) where stale prints inflate reversal IC that cannot be captured. Value of running it: high regardless of outcome — it closes the last unmeasured horizon band on OHLC and the G-A-fail branch composes with TASK_915's fail branch into the memo's pre-committed D4 repeal.
open_doubts: σ_d,resid = 350 bp and N_eff = 8 are assumptions; the required-IC line scales ∝ 1/σ and weakly with N_eff — both are measured inside the experiment, but the prior odds quoted use the assumptions.

21 bp/side on a Σ|Δw| accounting is almost certainly optimistic for low-activity alts at hourly cadence (spread + impact); a 5 bp adverse-selection term moves the fast-end required IC by ~25% (cost/day 35 → 43 bp at HL 6 h). 907's markout deciles are the only in-house calibration and are BTC/ETH-centric.
Shortability: the Kraken spot-margin eligible set and borrow cost are unrecorded; a mostly-long residual book is not market-neutral and the BEAR-positive claim then rests on the edge alone.

Hourly returns on a stale tape contain bid-ask bounce; the 1-bar entry lag guards against it but also discards genuine sub-hour reversal — the lag-vs-no-lag IC gap is itself the measurement and may leave the honest IC near zero.
GP's AR(1)-per-component assumption may misfit if IC decays non-exponentially (fast/slow mixture); the k-component aim handles mixtures but φ̂_k estimation error feeds turnover directly.

The turnover/TC closed forms above assume Gaussian scores and w ∝ z; real Σ|Δw| adds universe entry/exit and renormalisation turnover (the trend book's measured 0.155/day is essentially all sign flips), so the required-IC line must be recomputed on the measured τ, as the design states.

`eval_vector --bar-minutes 60` strides the minute grid ([::60], `env_factory.py:417`) — the decision price is minute 0 of each hour, which must be reconciled with the true hourly bar's close/open convention before the two-instrument agreement is meaningful.
Minute canon ends 2026-03-31 (899 seam); the 2026 read is one quarter — under-powered for a by-year positivity gate on its own.

Literature depth: no source was read in full in this session (WebSearch budget exhausted; abstracts via Crossref/arXiv/NBER); the GP formulas and the Nagel/Lo–MacKinlay/Yang–Zhang/Bailey–López de Prado claims are from memory and should be verified against the papers before the SPEC cites them.

Composition risk with TASK_915: both instruments share the residual-target/IC machinery; running them as one module with two panels (daily, hourly) avoids two divergent IC estimators and keeps the multiplicity accounting honest — a planner decision.
